description: Resolved-policy inputs for 1B fixtures: write_file and read_file allowed; _default denied.
rewrite:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
  read_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        starts_with: "/safe/"
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: block, block_action: rewrite }
error:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
  read_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        starts_with: "/safe/"
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: block, block_action: error }
off:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
  read_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        starts_with: "/safe/"
layers:
  L0: { mode: "off" }
shadow_mode:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
  read_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        starts_with: "/safe/"
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: shadow }
l1:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
  read_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        starts_with: "/safe/"
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: block, block_action: rewrite }
  L1: { mode: shadow, threshold: 0.5 }
